results.party_as_written: המחנה הממלכתי בראשות בני גנץ, גדעון סער וגדי איזנקוט

questions.notes: Question framed around the (real, that-day) Eisenkot joining Gantz-Saar - treated as main since this became the actual list. Table gives seats only; pct only for below-threshold parties. undecided_pct 24.2 is the combined 'לא יודע/לא מתכוון להצביע' row. הרשימה המשותפת as one list -> חד"ש-תע"ל.
